papers.title_en: FastEEP: Fast Intra-Instance Elastic Scaling for Expert-Parallel MoE Serving
papers.authors: Yunfei Feng, Jingkai He, Shiqi Liu, Cheng Zhang, Dong Du, Erhu Feng
papers.evidence: 面向MoE服务的弹性专家并行扩缩容基础设施
papers.tldr: 生产环境中的MoE通常采用大规模专家并行，而LLM请求负载持续波动，单纯增删服务实例需销毁并重建运行环境，扩缩容代价高。FastEEP面向实例内专家并行组伸缩，以“部分复用”为原则，将可复用执行结构与当前并行配置激活的资源分离，并协同回收和重配工作线程、显存与通信资源。实验表明，它相较现有基于vLLM的方案将扩缩容加速4.5至11.7倍，支持更细粒度、高效率的MoE在线容量调节。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale expert parallelism (EP) has become the standard deployment configuration for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models in production. Meanwhile, the highly dynamic nature of LLM workloads requires providers to continuously adjust serving capacity to match fluctuating demand. Scaling MoE serving cannot be efficiently achieved by simply adding or removing serving instances; instead, it often requires resizing the EP group within an existing instance, which we refer to as intra-instance scaling.Existing inference engines primarily rely on instance-level scaling, which destroys and reconstructs entire serving instances, incurring substantial scaling overhead.   We present FastEEP (Fast Elastic Expert Parallel), a fast intra-instance scaling system for MoE serving based on the principle of Partial Reuse. FastEEP reuses existing runtime state across worker execution, GPU memory, and communication by separating reusable execution structures from the resources activated by the current EP configuration. This separation enables coordinated resource reclamation and reconfiguration while preserving costly-to-reconstruct state, allowing fast EP scaling without full instance teardown and reconstruction. Our evaluation shows that FastEEP achieves 4.5x--11.7x faster scaling than the existing vLLM-based approach across different models, enabling efficient, fine-grained scaling of MoE serving.

papers.title_en: JointServe: Serving Multi-Model Agents on Memory-Constrained GPUs
papers.evidence: 面向多模型大语言模型服务的显存驻留管理
papers.tldr: 多模型智能体需在不同专家模型间频繁切换，但私有与边缘GPU显存有限，整模型换入换出会阻塞计算并丢失会话KV状态。JointServe将权重分片与KV块纳入统一显存预算，利用调用意图、间歇执行和双状态驻留提前准备模型。其通过生成中预取、部分k*层驻留、KV带宽保障及动态配额调整降低切换开销。在多类真实轨迹上显著缩短会话完成时间并提升SLO达标率，使显存受限环境下的多模型代理服务可用。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are evolving from a single model calling tools to planners that orchestrate multiple expert models whose capabilities live in distinct weights. This shift breaks a hidden assumption of today's serving systems: that the working set of models fits in GPU memory. On the memory-constrained GPUs typical of private and edge deployments, naive whole-model swapping serializes weight transfer with computation and, without host-backed KV restoration, discards session state at a switch. We present JointServe, a serving system that treats weight shards and KV blocks as residency objects competing for one unified memory budget. JointServe exploits three structural properties of agent workloads (directed calls, gapped execution, and dual-state residency) to prepare models before they are called: an intent signal parsed from the caller's own output stream triggers prefetch during generation, partial k* residency reduces switching to incremental layers, and a preemptive transfer scheduler protects live-session KV with a guaranteed bandwidth share. A carve-out control step adjusts the weight/KV allocation as workload demands change. Evaluations show that JointServe reduces session completion time by 21.7% over the strongest whole-model swap baseline and stays usable in a crash regime where every whole-model swap baseline fails to finish (a 46-fold gap). On replayed SWE-bench, tau-bench, and OSWorld traces, it cuts session completion time by up to 49% and lifts SLO attainment from 2.8-24.5% to 76.8-100%.

papers.title_en: Architecting for Hardware Diversity: Meta's End-to-End Co-Design for High-Performance AI Training on AMD GPUs
papers.authors: Haoyu Zhang, Arshad Rahman, Adnan Aziz, Ajith Prabhudev, Amin Farmahini, Ben Rhoads, Benson Ma, Brian Shi, Cen Zhao, CK Luk, Dingming Wu, Emad El-Haraty, Eric Chen, Frank Li, Gary Huang, Gefei Zuo, Haoran Zhang, Hiwot Kassa, Hongyi Zeng, Jack Taylor, Jeremy Hadidjojo, John Donati, Jonathan Sheffield, Julio Machado Silva, Karthik Ganesan, Kent Russell, KR Kishore, Lei Tian, Liu Ke, Muhammad Osama, Peng Chen, Rakesh Hemnani, Ryan Swann, Saleel Kudchadker, Shankar Yanamandram, Shobhit Kanaujia, Shucai Xiao, Srinath Bayareddy, Srinivas Vaidyanathan, Sudharssun Subramanian, Supadchaya Puangpontip, Taylor Robie, Tianhao Huang, Tyler Hart, Viswesh Sankaran, Weijun Jiang, Wenkai Du, Xiaodong Wang, Xiaohu Guo, Yao Rong, Yinbin Ma, Yue Dong, Yuzhen Huang, Yvonne Liu, Zhan Shu, Dan Rabinovitsj, Ajit Mathews, Chunqiang Tang
papers.evidence: 面向异构GPU训练的端到端软硬件协同优化
papers.tldr: Meta 为降低成本并避免供应商锁定，在 NVIDIA、AMD 与自研 MTIA 的异构集群上训练推荐模型；但既有 CUDA 专用优化难以直接迁移。论文以 AMD MI350X 对比 NVIDIA B200 为例，通过硬件—模型协同设计、解析性能模型驱动的零预热内核选择，以及面向微架构的智能体移植流程释放硬件特性。相对直接移植基线，端到端训练吞吐最高提升 1.5 倍，并将成果回馈至 PyTorch、Triton 和 ROCm，提供了超大规模生产部署 AMD 训练的实践范式。
papers.abstract_en: Meta deploys a heterogeneous fleet comprising NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and proprietary MTIA accelerators to reduce costs and mitigate vendor lock-in. However, the extensive history of NVIDIA-specific optimizations hinders performance portability to other hardware. This paper presents our methods for optimizing alternative accelerators, using AMD Instinct MI350X versus NVIDIA B200 for recommendation model training as a case study. We propose three reusable principles. First, hardware-model co-design is essential: rather than directly porting models from NVIDIA GPUs, revising model structures and software recipes allows full exploitation of accelerator-specific strengths (e.g., MI350X's 1.6x HBM capacity relative to B200). Second, our analytical performance model enables zero-warmup optimal kernel selection across diverse datatypes and matrix shapes in production models, drastically simplifying tuning. Third, increasingly mature agentic workflows have lowered the barrier to porting from the CUDA ecosystem; we extend these workflows for microarchitecture-aware kernel optimizations and custom shim generation. Compared to the directly ported baseline, these methods deliver up to 1.5x improvement in end-to-end training throughput. To our knowledge, this is the first hyperscaler report on productionizing AMD GPUs for large-scale training. Our contributions have been upstreamed to the open-source PyTorch, Triton, and ROCm ecosystems.

papers.title_en: DFIT: A Framework for Building Instrumentation Tools Across Heterogeneous Dataflow Accelerators
papers.authors: Md. Azahar Alam, Abrar Hossain, Kishwar Ahmed
papers.evidence: 面向异构机器学习加速器的性能插桩框架
papers.tldr: 数据流AI加速器虽具备高能效和高吞吐，却缺少类似CPU与GPU的细粒度观测手段，编译、调度和硬件行为因此难以分析与调优。DFIT在图IR及后端降级阶段，基于语义程序表示直接插桩操作、区域和编译变换，采集反映真实数据流的高层信息并导出分析。该框架无需为不同平台改写工具逻辑，在Cerebras、SambaNova和TPU上实现跨平台可移植。不同插桩模式开销为3.53%至13.62%，为异构加速器提供可复现、架构感知的性能洞察基础。
papers.abstract_en: Emerging dataflow accelerators offer exceptional energy efficiency and throughput for machine learning workloads, yet remain largely opaque to developers for performance analysis. Unlike CPUs and GPUs, where instrumentation frameworks enable fine-grained introspection, dataflow hardware exposes little information. This lack of transparency limits the ability of compiler engineers, system designers, and application developers to analyze, tune, or debug accelerator behavior.   In this paper, we introduce DFIT (DataFlow Accelerator Instrumentation Tool), an instrumentation framework designed specifically for dataflow architectures. DFIT directly instruments operations, regions, and compiler transformations at the graph IR and backend-lowering stages using semantic program representation. DFIT captures high-level, semantically meaningful data that reflect the true dataflow of computation. These data can be exported for visualization and analysis. Our approach demonstrates how instrumentation can be generalized beyond traditional hardware to support heterogeneous architectures, providing portability without modifying tool logic.   By opening the black box of dataflow execution, DFIT establishes a foundation for new classes of performance analysis tools for AI accelerators. It provides a practical path toward reproducible, architecture-aware introspection across heterogeneous systems, bridging the long-standing visibility gap between compiler design, runtime scheduling, and hardware realization. Evaluation across Cerebras, SambaNova, and TPU shows practical overhead of 3.53%-13.62% across instrumentation modes with robust cross-platform portability.

papers.title_en: ShellElastic: Scalable Elastic Pretraining with Simultaneous Maximal Updates and Hyperparameter Transfer
papers.authors: Can Jin, Yan Kang, Yifan Gong, Chongjian Ge, Mingze Xu, Yuanjun Xiong, Dimitris N. Metaxas, Hongwu Peng
papers.evidence: 面向分布式可扩展性的弹性基础模型预训练
papers.tldr: 基础模型需适配不同推理预算，逐尺寸预训练代价高，而现有弹性网络还受分布式负载波动、超参数难迁移和子网更新不一致限制。ShellElastic将隐藏维划为稠密核心与逐层外壳，构造块下三角矩阵，使一次全宽前传精确包含各子网前缀状态，并保持固定计算图。配套μE参数化让所有子网同时满足最大更新，并可随宽度和外壳数扩展。实验显示，单次训练得到的子网在同参数量下优于MatFormer和全弹性基线，接近多次独立训练效果，显著降低多预算部署的预训练重复成本。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models need to support diverse inference budgets, yet training a separate model for each budget duplicates pretraining effort. Elastic models train several nested sub-networks inside one weight-shared supernet, but existing recipes face three obstacles: variable per-step workloads that hinder distributed scaling, limited hyperparameter (HP) transfer across model sizes, and no guarantee that all sub-networks are maximally updated at once. We present \Ours, an elastic transformer that organizes hidden dimensions into a dense core and successive shells, so that every hidden matrix is block lower triangular. One full-width forward pass contains every sub-network's exact hidden states as prefixes, so joint training keeps a fixed computation graph and costs about as much per step as training the widest sub-network alone. We further introduce \muE, an extension of maximal update parameterization (\mup) to \Ours and other elastic architectures. Its scaling rules provably keep all sub-networks of a supernet maximally updated simultaneously (\muI), and keep doing so when the supernet is widened or given more shells; sweeps confirm that HPs tuned on a small non-elastic proxy stay near-optimal for elastic families and larger supernets (\mbox{\muT}). A single \Ours run produces sub-networks that outperform MatFormer and fully elastic baselines at matched parameter counts, and approach separately trained models that together take several times the steps.

papers.title_en: BARTER: Compact Dynamic Sparse Training with Standard Dense Kernels
papers.authors: Yueyuan Sui, Payal Mohapatra, Qi Zhu, Stephen Xia
papers.evidence: 利用紧凑动态稀疏张量和稠密内核优化训练成本
papers.tldr: 动态稀疏训练虽可减少有效参数，但多数方法仍保留完整张量尺寸，训练加速依赖专用稀疏算子。BARTER通过物理压缩训练张量，并在层间动态重分配注意力头和前馈通道容量。它仅利用活跃单元反向传播统计进行剪枝与克隆，并重映射优化器状态。在视觉Transformer实验中，该方法兼顾精度与效率，最高实现6.29倍加速和81.3%显存降低。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic sparse training (DST) aims to reduce training costs while maintaining accuracy. Existing DST methods mask out parameters but keep matrix dimensions unchanged. Training speedups therefore depend on specialized support, such as sparse kernels. We introduce BARTER, a structured DST framework that reduces training cost using standard dense kernels by keeping training tensors physically compact while dynamically reallocating capacity across layers. Unlike existing works that require computing gradients for all parameters, BARTER instead uses statistics collected only from active units during ordinary backpropagation to prune and clone attention heads and feed-forward channels under separate fixed global budgets. At each topology update, it resizes the affected parameter tensors and remaps their optimizer states, so subsequent training steps operate directly on the compact model. Training and fine-tuning experiments with Transformer-based vision models on two image classification benchmarks at densities from $0.1$ to $0.7$ show competitive Top-1 accuracy relative to full-tensor DST baselines. On an NVIDIA L40, BARTER achieves speedups of up to $6.29\times$ in measured training segments and reduces peak allocated GPU memory by up to $81.3\%$ relative to these implementations. An iPhone 13 Pro Max training benchmark additionally shows a $2.78\times$ speedup over the full-tensor DST baseline.

papers.title_en: How Inner Optimizers Shape Replica Scaling
papers.authors: Eugene Belilovsky, Stefan Horoi, Edouard Oyallon, Benjamin Thérien
papers.evidence: 分析地理分布式LLM副本扩展中的优化器选择
papers.tldr: 在跨数据中心、低互联算力池训练大模型时，固定总训练预算下增加模型副本通常会持续损害性能。论文分析不同内层优化器，指出伪梯度协方差结构及批大小改变的噪声尺度是副本扩展退化的关键。理论与实验表明，基于白化的预条件能有效改善这一问题。在8至96个副本上，此类优化器表现出更强扩展性，且随参数和数据规模增大，相对数据并行的性能更佳。
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) across geographically distributed and poorly interconnected compute pools or data centers has become a topic of significant interest. This has led to increased study of local optimization methods such as DiLoco for LLMs, especially those that use local (or inner) adaptive or preconditioned optimizers, which are critical for high-performance LLM training. However, a central challenge remains: it is well known that increasing the number of model replicas (replica scaling) while fixing the total training budget leads to monotonically decreasing performance. Existing work has empirically demonstrated that the choice of inner optimizer (Muon v.s. AdamW) can significantly improve this trend, but offers only limited explanation of the performance difference. In this work, we consider a range of inner-optimizers and identify two important factors that impact replica scaling: (1) the covariance structure of the pseudo-gradients and (2) the impact of batch size on the pseudogradient's noise scale. Based on these insights, we theoretically and empirically demonstrate that whitening-based pre-conditioning is a powerful inner-optimizer desideratum. Our empirical evaluation extends the results to reveal that whitening-based inner-optimizers achieve strong replica scaling (for 8-96 replicas), with performance relative to DP improving as parameters and data are scaled.

papers.title_en: NOMAI: Scalable Federated Learning with Private Weights
papers.authors: Yiyi Sun, Mushtari Sadia, Amrita Roy Chowdhury
papers.evidence: 可扩展安全联邦学习系统架构
papers.tldr: 联邦学习需同时保护参与者数据、模型权重并保证训练完整性，但在单协调方和百万用户场景下，现有方案难以兼顾三项安全目标与扩展性。NOMAI以多委员会MPC和打包Shamir秘密共享实现类似SIMD的批量安全计算，并用机器学习感知优化及新密码原语降低用户开销。MNIST训练中，半诚实和恶意中止模型的每轮单用户计算分别低于350毫秒、700毫秒，且可支持超过百万用户。该系统首次证明MPC联邦学习能在隐私和完整性不妥协时满足真实部署的规模需求。
papers.abstract_en: The twin goals of privacy-preserving federated learning (FL) -- harnessing distributed data while protecting the parties who contribute it -- demands three properties: model privacy, data privacy, and integrity. Achieving all three in a realistic deployment -- with a single coordinator and millions of users -- remains an open challenge that prior work has yet to fully resolve. We present NOMAI, the first scalable MPC-based FL system to provide all three guarantees simultaneously. NOMAI operates under an honest-majority assumption in the semi-honest model, with an extension to the malicious-with-abort setting. At its core, NOMAI combines a multi-committee MPC architecture with packed Shamir secret sharing, enabling SIMD-style secure computation that scales far beyond what monolithic n-party protocols can support. We further introduce ML-aware optimizations and new cryptographic primitives that substantially reduce per-user overhead. Our evaluation shows NOMAI is practically deployable at unprecedented scale: it reduces per-user computation to just <350 ms (semi-honest) and <700 ms (malicious) for per iteration of training MNIST, achieving three orders-of-magnitude improvements over prior work while seamlessly supporting populations of over 106 users. This demonstrates, for the first time, that MPC-based FL can meet the scale demands of real-world systems without compromising on privacy or integrity.

papers.title_en: Linear-Time Non-Local Codec Placement for Machine Learning Model Compression
papers.evidence: 面向硬件的机器学习计算图优化
papers.tldr: 端侧推理受模型存储和操作数传输限制，压缩表示虽可减少流量，却需编解码算子，局部插入常抵消收益。论文提出面向目标硬件的线性时间编解码放置算法，通过为计算图边着色构造满足支配关系的连通子图。每个子图的绝对支配节点成为观测流量并学习参数化编解码器的自然位置。相较朴素局部放置，该方法在四个模型上将建模操作数流量降低24%至44%，为硬件兼容压缩提供高效图级优化。
papers.abstract_en: On-device inference imposes constraints on model storage and operand traffic and thus benefits from compressed operand representations, which mandate the use of encoding and decoding operators. However, naïve placement of codec operators can cancel the operand traffic gains sought from compression. In this work, I present an algorithm to place codec operators into a source computational graph to make it compatible with target hardware. The edges of the graph are colored so that each induced subgraph is weakly connected and has a maximal node that both postdominates all subgraph inputs and dominates all subgraph outputs; this unique node - dubbed the $\textit{absolute dominator}$ - is the natural location to observe the traffic flowing through the subgraph and learn parametric codec operators. The algorithm's time complexity is linear in the source graph's size. With respect to naïve local codec placement, the algorithm reduces modeled operand traffic by $24\%$-$44\%$ across four models, including $24\%$ on SigLIP and $34\%$ on SmolLM2.

papers.title_en: Beyond Aggregate Drift: Optimal Client-Specific Windows in Federated Learning
papers.authors: Yuriy Dorn, Dmitrii Vishovan, Kirill Novoselov, Ilya Kuruzov, Darina Dvinskikh, Alexander Gasnikov
papers.evidence: 面向联邦分布式训练的客户端自适应优化
papers.tldr: 联邦学习中的客户端数据持续到达且分布随时间漂移，不同客户端的数据速率、噪声和漂移速度并不一致，统一历史窗口会造成失配。论文为每个客户端按其噪声、到达率和漂移率分配独立记忆窗口，并以共同初始点重启加速优化。所得跟踪误差界为R(Σw_m^{3/2}σ_m√(γ_m/λ_m))^{2/3}，不劣于任意公共窗口；下界验证其近最优性，实验也表明收益主要来自个性化记忆机制。
papers.abstract_en: We study federated learning from continuously arriving data: each client samples from its own distribution, these distributions drift over time, and the server must track the minimizer of the clients' weighted average loss. Clients are not alike as they collect data at different rates, with different noise, and change at different speeds. The main question is how much history should each one keep? A single shared window must serve every client at once, and so makes a fast-changing client carry the sampling noise of a slow, nearly stationary one.   We give each client a memory of its own, sized to that client's noise, arrival rate, and drift, and refresh it by restarted accelerated method that starts from a common point. The tracking error is then bounded by \[   R\left(\sum_m w_m^{3/2}\,σ_m\sqrt{γ_m/λ_m}\right)^{2/3}, \] for clients with weight $w_m$, noise $σ_m$, arrival rate $λ_m$, and drift rate $γ_m$ on a domain of diameter $R$. This is never worse than what any common window can achieve, and strictly better whenever noise and drift are spread unevenly across clients.   A lower bound that puts different groups of clients on different drift clocks shows this quantity is the right one. The two bounds agree up to a constant whenever the clients occupy boundedly many refresh scales, and in general differ only by the sixth root of the number of scales. Experiments show the gain comes from the memory rather than from the solver: it persists across accelerated, stochastic-gradient, and one-step methods, and against a separately tuned common-memory baseline.

papers.title_en: Adaptive Role Assignment and Controlled Feature Reconstruction for Federated Image Semantic Communication
papers.authors: Yuxuan Chen, Jiao Bie, Hang Qi, Jingjin Wu
papers.evidence: 具备自适应客户端角色的通信感知联邦训练框架
papers.tldr: 混合联邦语义通信中，终端既可上传模型更新也可上传语义特征，但角色成本、上行信道波动及特征重构与聚合方向失配会损害效果。ARC-FedSC在固定通信预算下联合优化终端分工和服务端重构：Role-Bandit结合历史贡献与当前RAN状态选角，TCA按近期聚合方向约束重构。CIFAR-10时变信道实验中，五种角色配置后期均优于基线，最佳近20轮平均PSNR达24.17 dB。有害重构概率降62%，并提升终端覆盖，说明方案能增强RAN部署中的稳定性与资源利用。
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid federated semantic communication enables user equipment (UEs) to contribute model updates or semantic features under a shared training framework. However, heterogeneous role costs and the interaction between model aggregation and feature reconstruction (FR) remain key challenges in practical radio access network (RAN) deployment. To address these issues, we propose ARC-FedSC, a RAN-aware framework that coordinates UE role assignment and server-side controlled FR under a fixed communication budget. Within ARC-FedSC, RAN Aware Role-Bandit learns the historical contribution of UEs in different roles together with current uplink conditions, while Temporal Consistency Alignment (TCA) regulates FR according to recent model aggregation directions. Experiments on CIFAR-10 with time-varying RAN channels show that ARC-FedSC outperforms baselines across all five tested role configurations in the later training stage, with the best configurations achieving about 24.17 dB average PSNR over the last 20 rounds. Component level results further show that Role-Bandit maintains an average rolling UE coverage of 85.3%, compared with about 65.7% for baseline, while TCA reduces the probability of harmful FR events from 0.245 to 0.093, corresponding to a 62.0% reduction. Ablation and sensitivity studies further support the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed design.

papers.title_en: Context-Aware Precision Scheduling for Small Language Models
papers.authors: Mukund Athmaram, Manoj Rao, Liang Ma
papers.evidence: 面向端侧大模型推理的上下文感知精度调度
papers.tldr: 端侧智能体中的小语言模型随上下文变长，KV缓存读取会挤占权重运算时间，使针对短上下文选定的固定混合精度配置难以持续兼顾延迟与准确性。论文以不同精度、不同上下文长度的实测执行成本校准时延预测器，而非仅按权重字节数估算速度，并结合张量敏感度在延迟或误差预算下分配权重精度。系统预先生成张量格式切换日程，运行时保留会话KV缓存并按日程执行。笔记本GPU上的工具调用与长上下文测试显示，按上下文调整精度可改善权衡，但KV缓存量化误差会限制权重升精度带来的准确性恢复。
papers.abstract_en: Small language models (SLMs) used as on-device agents must balance accuracy and latency as their context grows. Mixed precision helps manage this tradeoff by assigning different precisions to weight tensors according to their size and sensitivity. However, these choices depend on the operating conditions, so a configuration selected for a short context may no longer provide the best tradeoff at a longer one. We calibrate a timing model from measurements at different precisions and context lengths, and combine it with tensor sensitivities to choose configurations under a latency or accuracy budget. We argue that fewer bits do not always mean faster execution, so our predictor estimates latency from calibrated execution costs rather than weight bytes alone. Under a latency budget, reading the larger key-value (KV) cache leaves less time for weight operations, leading the allocator to select lower precisions. This gives a schedule of tensor changes that can be prepared before execution. Our runtime follows the schedule while retaining the session's KV cache. We evaluate executed schedules on a laptop GPU, including a longer-context schedule with three weight formats and a tool-use benchmark measuring full response time and correctness. Under an accuracy budget, measured error from a quantized KV cache determines the budget left for weights. The allocator can raise or lower weight precision as this estimate changes. These experiments show where context-aware precision helps and where accuracy recovery remains limited.

papers.title_en: Scaling Repeated-Data Pretraining: Batch Size, Regularization, and GPU-Time Tradeoffs
papers.evidence: 面向大规模预训练的GPU时间与训练配方优化
papers.tldr: 在算力充裕而独特训练数据有限的预训练中，模型必须多轮重复读取同一数据，传统单遍训练配方未必适用。论文联合优化批大小、训练轮数及数据重打包、权重绑定和嵌入衰减等策略，并将GPU数量与墙钟时间分开考察。验证损失随批大小呈U形，小批量通常更优，但其串行训练更慢；期限紧时可用更多GPU和较大批量折中。研究为重复数据预训练的配方选择与资源配置提供了新准则。
papers.abstract_en: We study pretraining when compute is abundant but unique training data are finite, requiring repeated training on the same data. We first revisit infinite-compute pretraining (Kim et al. 2026) and show that its frontier depends critically on choices previously fixed or studied only in isolation. In particular, optimizing batch size together with epoch counts reveals a U-shaped relationship between validation loss and batch size, favoring smaller batches than typical pretraining, likely because small-batch gradient noise provides implicit regularization. We further find that training recipes, previously optimized under a single-pass assumption, can be tuned, e.g., repacking documents into new sequences every epoch, weight tying, and positive embedding weight decay.   We then relax the infinite-compute assumption. In particular, smaller-than-typical batch sizes can require prohibitively long sequential training, motivating to treat GPUs and time as separate resources. Tighter deadlines favor larger batches, and latency-oriented parallelism can trade additional GPUs for shorter training. Nevertheless, even under a fixed time budget, a smaller batch with fewer GPUs can achieve lower validation loss than a larger batch with more GPUs, challenging the common practice of increasing data parallelism to maximize GPU utilization under a deadline. Together, our results identify underexplored factors in repeated-data training and provide concrete guidance on how training recipes and resource allocation should change from single-pass pretraining.

papers.title_en: MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization
papers.authors: Yangchengyu Zhou, Zhiping Wu, Runchang Jiang, Dongdong Ren, Youfang Han, Wei Zhao, Dongqi Cai, Wenbin Li
papers.evidence: 面向LLM服务的预算感知KV缓存内存管理
papers.tldr: 长上下文与复杂推理时，KV Cache 是大语言模型推理显存的主要瓶颈，而现有量化往往分别优化逐层精度或逐令牌保留，难以在固定预算下统筹资源。MultiAlloc通过轻量离线剖析层敏感度和令牌重要性，在层级精度增强与令牌级保留之间自适应分配量化资源。实验显示，它在相同内存预算下稳定优于多类基线。该工作将KV量化从单一压缩策略推进为面向预算的联合精度分配问题。
papers.abstract_en: The Key-Value (KV) cache constitutes a dominant source of memory consumption during large language model (LLM) inference, particularly in long-context and complex reasoning scenarios. Existing KV cache quantization methods have explored different compression granularities, including layer-wise precision adjustment and token-level information preservation. In practical deployment, however, the key challenge is not merely compression, but how to allocate limited quantization resources among heterogeneous precision preservation strategies under a fixed KV cache memory budget. We propose MultiAlloc, a profiling-guided precision allocation framework for KV cache quantization that adaptively distributes limited quantization resources between layer-wise precision enhancement and token-wise preservation. MultiAlloc employs lightweight offline profiling to characterize layer sensitivity and token importance, enabling adaptive precision allocation under a fixed memory constraint. Guided by the profiled memory--accuracy trade-off, it automatically derives an effective precision allocation strategy without online allocation search, and applies the resulting policy during inference. Extensive experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks demonstrate that MultiAlloc consistently improves over layer-wise, token-wise, and recent multi-granularity KV cache quantization methods under matched memory budgets across diverse models, including Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek-Qwen, and QwQ.

papers.title_en: VLCQ: Post-training quantization for deep neural networks using variable length coding
papers.authors: Reem Abdel-Salam, Ahmed H. Abdel-Gawad, Amr G. Wassal
papers.evidence: 面向高效深度模型部署的训练后量化
papers.tldr: 后训练量化无需原始数据或完整再训练，适合受限设备部署，但常规高精度方案多依赖INT8，进一步降位宽会显著损失精度。VLCQ解除定点编码限制，以可变长度编码扩展量化表示选择，无需微调即可在压缩率与精度间灵活折中。其在分类、分割和检测任务上表现突出：逐通道最高较FP32压缩6倍、较PWLQ压缩1.7倍；容许不足4%性能下降时最高达12.25倍。该方法表明非定长表示可提升数据无关量化的低比特部署能力。
papers.abstract_en: Quantization plays a crucial role in efficiently deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained devices. Post-training quantization does not require access to the original dataset or retraining the full model. Current methods that achieve high performance close to baseline results typically require INT8 fixed-point integers. However, achieving higher model compression with lower bit-widths often leads to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose VLCQ, a post-training quantization method that relaxes the fixed-point encoding constraint, enabling more flexible exploration of quantization techniques through variable-length encoding. This approach achieves competitive or improved performance while reducing bit-widths, without requiring access to training data or model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on image classification, segmentation, and object detection demonstrate that VLCQ improves model compression and accuracy compared with state-of-the-art post-training quantization approaches. For per-channel quantization, VLCQ surpasses FP32 accuracy and Piece-Wise Linear Quantization (PWLQ) on most evaluated models, achieving up to 6x compression compared with FP32 and up to 1.7x compared with PWLQ. When prioritizing compression with limited accuracy loss, VLCQ achieves up to 12.25x compression compared with FP32 with less than 4% performance degradation. For per-tensor quantization, VLCQ is competitive with Data-Free Quantization (DFQ), while providing greater flexibility to achieve lower bit rates across different tasks and models.

papers.title_en: SARATHI: Decoupled Data-Free Probing and Adaptive Reconstruction for Structured LLM Pruning
papers.authors: Sankar Behera, Dhruv Singh, Satyadev Ahlawat, Yamuna Prasad
papers.evidence: 面向大模型部署的内存高效结构化剪枝
papers.tldr: 结构化剪枝通过永久删除神经元和权重行实现稠密、硬件无关的推理加速，但现有后训练方案以同一校准集同时负责筛选与重构，易受领域偏差并在高稀疏率下出现显存瓶颈。SARATHI将两阶段解耦：无数据的NMF残差子空间探针按权重内在几何打分，局部批次自适应OBS重构，并补偿后层归一化架构的偏置漂移。在两类架构六个模型、15%至40%稀疏率上，其困惑度具竞争力，零样本准确率持平或超过基线，为高稀疏结构化剪枝提供低内存路径。
papers.abstract_en: Structured pruning reduces the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by permanently removing neurons and weight rows, yielding dense, hardware-agnostic speedup. Existing post-training methods couple neuron selection and weight reconstruction through a shared calibration dataset, introducing domain bias and out-of-memory failures at high sparsity. We propose SARATHI, a framework that decouples these two stages. A data-free \emph{NMF Residual Subspace Probe} scores neurons using intrinsic weight geometry, without accessing any calibration data, and carries a formal connection to Robust PCA. \emph{Adaptive OBS} then reconstructs the pruned weights with a localized calibration batch, operating in $\mathcal{O}(d^2)$ peak memory per layer and eliminating the global memory bottleneck of coupled methods. A \emph{Bias Shift Compensation} step corrects systematic activation drift in post-LayerNorm architectures that would otherwise cause perplexity collapse at high sparsity. Experiments across six models from two architecture families (gated and non-gated FFN) at 15--40\% sparsity show that SARATHI achieves competitive perplexity and matches or exceeds existing structured pruning baselines on zero-shot accuracy.

papers.title_en: StructZO: Structured Zeroth-Order Optimization for Memory-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Xuanlin Yang, Jia Li, Zhouchen Lin
papers.evidence: 面向大规模语言模型微调的内存高效优化
papers.tldr: 大规模语言模型微调受反向传播激活与优化器状态内存限制，零阶优化虽仅需前向评估，却明显落后于Adam。StructZO在激活诱导的信息子空间中进行大查询零阶估计，并在低维更新回写前实施谱控制。理论上，其将有效估计维度由mn降至mr，投影误差受激活Gram矩阵谱尾约束。实验在OPT与Llama3.1-8B多任务上较最佳零阶基线平均相对提升最高8.7%、单任务最高26.9%，与一阶Adam平均差距缩至1.5%以内。
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning large language models at scale is increasingly limited by the memory cost of backpropagation. Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimizers reduce this burden by relying only on forward function evaluations, but they still exhibit a substantial performance gap to first-order (FO) optimizers such as Adam. We argue that this gap does not arise solely from the absence of explicit gradients: FO fine-tuning also benefits from informative low-rank optimization geometry, large-scale signal aggregation, and well-conditioned update directions. Motivated by this, we introduce StructZO, a structured Zeroth-Order optimization framework for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning. StructZO performs large-query ZO estimation within an activation-induced informative subspace and applies spectral control to the resulting reduced-space update before mapping it back to the original parameters. This lets ZO aggregate useful directional signals in a compact, geometry-aware space while avoiding the activation and optimizer-state memory costs of backpropagation. We show theoretically that, when the induced subspace captures concentrated optimization-relevant directions, StructZO reduces the effective ZO estimation dimension from $mn$ to $mr$, with the remaining projection error governed by the spectral tail of the activation Gram matrix. Empirically, across OPT-series and Llama3.1-8B on diverse downstreamtasks, StructZO improves over the strongest existing ZO baselines by up to $8.7%$ relative on average and up to $26.9%$ relative on individual tasks, while remaining within $1.5%$ of FO-Adam on average. These results suggest that structured and spectrally controlled ZO updates can substantially narrow the gap between ZO and FO optimization.
